github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This is a Flutter cross-platform music player supporting Windows/Android/iOS/macOS/Linux/Web/AndroidTV. Use Riverpod for state management, go_router for navigation, JSON scan cache and SharedPreferences metadata, just_audio for playback. All UI strings must use AppLocalizations (l10n). All colors must use colorScheme. Never hardcode strings or colors. Use flutter_secure_storage for credentials. All UI implementation goes to Antigravity with taste skill in the fixed OmniTune conversation listed in docs/PROJECT_PROGRESS.md. See AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md for full rules.

github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Use flutter_test and mocktail for testing. Test files go in test/ mirroring the lib/ structure. Mock all network calls. For MusicSource implementations, always test connect/disconnect/listFiles/buildPlayableTrack. For scrapers, mock HTTP responses.
